summary: The code is syntactically correct and imports are fine. It implements a reasonably complete agent-based simulation with social influence, information, policy, enforcement, retail, and optional disease dynamics, and it calls main() directly as required. However, it does not fully implement the specified entities/interactions/metrics: Household dynamics and GovernmentAgency are missing, observational norms by location are not modeled, several required metrics are absent or misnamed, and some parameters from the spec are not honored. There are also minor logic/design mismatches (module dependency not enforced) and minor performance considerations during calibration.

issues.description: Household entity and associated behaviors (sharing masks, intra-household influence) are not implemented, despite being required by the spec.
issues.location: Entities and interactions; no Household class or modules
issues.solution: Add a Household class with attributes and behaviors per spec and a module to handle intra-household influence and mask sharing. Integrate into scheduler and adoption dynamics.

issues.description: GovernmentAgency entity from the spec is not implemented; a simplified PolicyAuthority is used instead. Attributes like campaign_intensity, enforcement resources, information quality, and messaging tone are not modeled explicitly.
issues.solution: Introduce a GovernmentAgency entity per spec or align PolicyAuthority to the spec attributes and wire them into policy issuance, enforcement allocation, and information campaigns.

issues.description: Observational norms within locations (visibility of mask use affecting immediate compliance and future adoption) are not explicitly modeled.
issues.solution: Compute per-location visible mask rates among present contacts and add a location-norms influence term into the adoption decision and immediate compliance probabilities.

issues.description: Several required metrics are missing or misaligned with the spec: location_compliance by location type, stockout_days, purchases_per_capita, de_adoption_rate (aggregated), policy_efficiency, and optional_cases_averted.
issues.solution: Track and report per-location compliance, count days with retailer stockout, compute total purchases per capita, aggregate de-adoption rate over the horizon, compute policy_efficiency as adoption increase per unit policy cost, and compute cases averted as cumulative(counterfactual - observed) when disease dynamics are enabled.

issues.description: Parameter name mismatch: the spec uses include_disease_dynamics; the code expects disease_module_enabled. The spec’s network_model, rationing_policy, misinformation_prevalence, and other parameters are not consistently implemented or honored.
issues.location: Simulation.reset parameter handling and module toggling
issues.solution: Map include_disease_dynamics to disease_module_enabled, honor network_model settings (small_world/ER/scale_free with rewiring_probability), implement rationing_policy behavior, and model misinformation prevalence in InformationBroadcast and Person state.

issues.description: Module dependencies are declared but not enforced by the scheduler. PolicyModule declares a dependency on DiseaseDynamics but runs before it, implicitly using previous-day prevalence.
issues.location: DAGScheduler and module ordering in Simulation.reset
issues.solution: Either enforce dependencies in the DAGScheduler or document and ensure correct execution order explicitly. If intending to use current-day prevalence, reorder modules accordingly.

issues.description: Adoption inequality is captured via mask access Gini and a daily political disparity index, but the spec calls for adoption_inequality across demographic groups or network communities as a metric.
issues.solution: Compute and report variance or Gini of adoption rates across specified groups (age, income, communities) and aggregate into a metric aligned with adoption_inequality.

issues.description: Location compliance by type (workplace, transit, retail) is not computed as a metric.
issues.solution: Track per-location-type visitor mask wearing and aggregate to a location_compliance metric.

issues.description: Spec attributes for Person (occupation, household_id, habit_strength, fatigue_level, info_openness, misinformation_belief_level, vaccination_status_optional) are absent.
issues.solution: Add the missing attributes and include them in decision-making (habit, fatigue, information openness, misinformation), even if initially with simple effects.

issues.description: Rationing policy parameter from the spec is not implemented beyond a daily per-person cap.
issues.solution: Implement rationing_policy options (e.g., none, per-household, priority groups) affecting purchase eligibility and limits.

issues.description: RandomSearchCalibrator runs multiple full simulations (default budget 20) with N=2000 agents, which may be slow in constrained environments.
issues.solution: Document performance expectations and optionally add a fast-eval mode (reduced agent count or shorter horizon) during calibration, or early stopping based on convergence.
